rules.topic: ProjectE Integration registers per-mod recipe-type mappers (27 addon classes) that teach ProjectE's EMC graph mapper how to price other mods' recipe types; an addon activates only when its mod is installed (requiredMods)

Addons matching mods in this pack: AppliedEnergistics (AE2), ArsNouveau, Botania, Create, FarmersDelight, ImmersiveEngineering, IndustrialForegoing, ManaAndArtifice, MysticalAgriculture — items from these mods can receive graph-computed EMC values through their modded recipes (elven trade, Create processing, apparatus recipes and similar), which base ProjectE cannot price

rules.topic: Integration adds recipe edges to ProjectE's mapper; it does not assign fixed EMC values. Resulting EMC still follows the base model (seed values + recipe graph, see the projecte rule file): if a chain bottoms out at an item with no value, downstream items stay valueless, and datapack custom conversions override the graph

value.model: mapper edges only; no fixed values
